vsm2.17:1.1: 570. Idāni ‘‘khandhāyatanadhātuindriyasaccapaṭiccasamuppādādibhedā dhammā bhūmī’’ti evaṃ vuttesu imissā paññāya bhūmibhūtesu dhammesu
vsm2.17:1.2: yasmā paṭiccasamuppādoceva, ādisaddena saṅgahitā paṭiccasamuppannā dhammā ca avasesā honti,
vsm2.17:2.1: Tattha avijjādayo tāva dhammā paṭiccasamuppādoti veditabbā.
vsm2.17:3.4: Jarāmaraṇaṃ, bhikkhave, aniccaṃ saṅkhataṃ paṭiccasamuppannaṃ khayadhammaṃ vayadhammaṃ virāgadhammaṃ nirodhadhammaṃ.
vsm2.17:3.5: Jāti, bhikkhave…pe… bhavo… upādānaṃ… taṇhā… vedanā… phasso… saḷāyatanaṃ… nāmarūpaṃ… viññāṇaṃ… saṅkhārā…
vsm2.17:3.6: avijjā, bhikkhave, aniccā saṅkhatā paṭiccasamuppannā khayadhammā vayadhammā virāgadhammā nirodhadhammā.
vsm2.17:3.7: Ime vuccanti, bhikkhave, paṭiccasamuppannā dhammā’’ti (saṃ. ni. 2.20).
vsm2.17:4.3: Paṭiccasamuppannā dhammāti tehi tehi paccayehi nibbattadhammā.
vsm2.17:5.6: uppādā vā tathāgatānaṃ anuppādā vā tathāgatānaṃ ṭhitāva sā dhātu dhammaṭṭhitatā dhammaniyāmatā idappaccayatā.
vsm2.17:5.7: Taṃ tathāgato abhisambujjhati abhisameti, abhisambujjhitvā abhisametvā ācikkhati deseti paññapeti paṭṭhapeti vivarati vibhajati uttānīkaroti, passathāti cāha.
vsm2.17:5.9: Bhavapaccayā, bhikkhave, jāti…pe… avijjāpaccayā, bhikkhave, saṅkhārā
vsm2.17:5.10: uppādā vā tathāgatānaṃ…pe… uttānīkaroti passathāti cāha.
vsm2.17:5.12: Iti kho, bhikkhave, yā tatra tathatā avitathatā anaññathatā idappaccayatā.
vsm2.17:5.13: Ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, paṭiccasamuppādo’’ti (saṃ. ni. 2.20). Evaṃ paṭiccasamuppādaṃ desentena tathatādīhi vevacanehi paccayadhammāva paṭiccasamuppādoti vuttā.
vsm2.17:6.1: 572. So panāyaṃ tehi tehi paccayehi anūnādhikeheva tassa tassa dhammassa sambhavato tathatāti,
vsm2.17:6.2: sāmaggiṃ upagatesu paccayesu muhuttampi tato nibbattadhammānaṃ asambhavābhāvato avitathatāti,
vsm2.17:6.4: yathāvuttānaṃ etesaṃ jarāmaraṇādīnaṃ paccayato vā paccayasamūhato vā idappaccayatāti vutto.
vsm2.17:8.2: 574. Keci pana paṭicca sammā ca titthiyaparikappitapakatipurisādikāraṇanirapekkho uppādo paṭiccasamuppādoti evaṃ
vsm2.17:9.4: Bhagavato hi ‘‘atha kho bhagavā rattiyā paṭhamaṃ yāmaṃ paṭiccasamuppādaṃ anulomapaṭilomaṃ manasākāsī’’ti (mahāva. 1) ādivacanato
vsm2.17:9.6: Yathāha ‘‘yena svāhaṃ, bhikkhave, vihārena paṭhamābhisambuddho viharāmi, tassa padesena vihāsi’’nti (saṃ. ni. 5.11).
vsm2.17:9.7: Tatra ca paccayākāradassanena vihāsi, na uppādamattadassanenāti.
vsm2.17:9.8: Yathāha ‘‘so evaṃ pajānāmi micchādiṭṭhipaccayāpi vedayitaṃ sammādiṭṭhipaccayāpi vedayitaṃ
vsm2.17:10.2: Kaccānasuttepi hi ‘‘lokasamudayaṃ kho, kaccāna, yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya passato yā loke natthitā, sā na hotī’’ti (saṃ. ni. 2.15)
vsm2.17:10.3: anulomapaṭiccasamuppādo lokapaccayato ‘‘lokasamudayo’’ti ucchedadiṭṭhisamugghātatthaṃ pakāsito, na uppādamattaṃ.
vsm2.17:10.4: Na hi uppādamattadassanena ucchedadiṭṭhiyā samugghāto hoti.
vsm2.17:11.2: ‘‘gambhīro cāyaṃ, ānanda, paṭiccasamuppādo gambhīrāvabhāso cā’’ti (dī. ni. 2.95; saṃ. ni. 2.60).
vsm2.17:11.3: Gambhīrattañca nāma catubbidhaṃ, taṃ parato vaṇṇayissāma.
vsm2.17:12.2: samāne kattari pubbakāle payujjamāno atthasiddhikaro hoti.
vsm2.17:12.3: Seyyathidaṃ, ‘‘cakkhuñca paṭicca rūpe ca uppajjati cakkhuviññāṇa’’nti (saṃ. ni. 2.43).
vsm2.17:12.4: Idha pana bhāvasādhanena uppādasaddena saddhiṃ payujjamāno samānassa kattu abhāvato saddabhedaṃ gacchati,
vsm2.17:12.5: na ca kiñci atthaṃ sādhetīti saddabhedatopi na uppādamattaṃ paṭiccasamuppādoti.
vsm2.17:13.5: ‘‘Paṭiccasamuppādaṃ vo, bhikkhave, desessāmi. Katamo ca, bhikkhave, paṭiccasamuppādo…pe… ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, paṭiccasamuppādo’’ti (saṃ. ni. 2.1).
vsm2.17:13.6: Imesu hi padesu ekenapi saddhiṃ hoti-saddo yogaṃ na gacchati, na ca uppādo hoti.
vsm2.17:14.2: bhāvo ca nāma yo ākāro avijjādīnaṃ saṅkhārādipātubhāve hetu, so.
vsm2.17:14.3: Tasmiñca saṅkhāravikāre paṭiccasamuppādasaññā’’ti, tesaṃ taṃ na yujjati.
vsm2.17:14.7: ‘‘tasmātiha, ānanda, eseva hetu, etaṃ nidānaṃ, esa samudayo, esa paccayo jarāmaraṇassa yadidaṃ jāti…pe… saṅkhārānaṃ, yadidaṃ avijjā’’ti (dī. ni. 2.98 ādayo) evaṃ avijjādayova hetūti vuttā, na tesaṃ vikāro.
vsm2.17:14.8: Tasmā ‘‘paṭiccasamuppādoti paccayadhammā veditabbā’’ti iti yaṃ taṃ vuttaṃ,
vsm2.17:15.1: 577. Yā panettha ‘‘paṭiccasamuppādo’’ti imāya byañjanacchāyāya uppādoyevāyaṃ vuttoti saññā uppajjati,
vsm2.17:15.2: sā imassa padassa evamatthaṃ gahetvā vūpasametabbā.
vsm2.17:15.4:
Dvedhā tato pavatte, dhammasamūhe yato idaṃ vacanaṃ;
Tappaccayo tatoyaṃ, phalopacārena iti vutto.
vsm2.17:16.1: Yo hi ayaṃ paccayatāya pavatto dhammasamūho, tattha paṭiccasamuppādoti idaṃ vacanaṃ dvidhā icchanti.
vsm2.17:16.2: So hi yasmā patīyamāno hitāya sukhāya ca saṃvattati,
vsm2.17:16.4: Uppajjamāno ca saha sammā ca uppajjati,
vsm2.17:16.6: Evaṃ paṭicco ca so samuppādo cāti paṭiccasamuppādo.
vsm2.17:16.10: Tassa cāyaṃ hetusamūho paccayoti tappaccayattā ayampi,
vsm2.17:16.11: yathā loke semhassa paccayo guḷo semho guḷoti vuccati,
vsm2.17:16.12: yathā ca sāsane sukhappaccayo buddhānaṃ uppādo ‘‘sukho buddhānaṃ uppādo’’ti vuccati, tathā paṭiccasamuppādo icceva phalavohārena vuttoti veditabbo.
vsm2.17:17.2:
Paṭimukhamitoti vutto, hetusamūho ayaṃ paṭiccoti;
Sahite uppādeti ca, iti vutto so samuppādo.
vsm2.17:18.1: Yo hi esa saṅkhārādīnaṃ pātubhāvāya avijjādiekekahetusīsena niddiṭṭho hetusamūho,
vsm2.17:18.2: so sādhāraṇaphalanipphādakaṭṭhena avekallaṭṭhena ca sāmaggiaṅgānaṃ aññamaññena paṭimukhaṃ ito gatoti katvā paṭiccoti vuccati.
vsm2.17:18.3: Svāyaṃ sahiteyeva aññamaññaṃ avinibbhogavuttidhamme uppādetīti samuppādotipi vutto.
vsm2.17:18.4: Evampi paṭicco ca so samuppādo cāti paṭiccasamuppādo.
